domain: intelligence analysis, reconnaissance and scouting doctrine, source grading, and structured analytic techniques
axioms: Collection and interpretation are separable operations with different licenses; conflating them is the standard route to unearned confidence.
Every speculative product carries provenance, a source grade, and a confidence grade that must survive every hop to the decision point.
A store without a read filter is a competing truth channel; separation is enforced by the reader, not by the writer's good intentions.
Speculation decays: unpromoted product must expire or be re-tasked rather than quietly inherited as background belief.
Tasking is upstream of collection; an operation with no tasking predicate fires arbitrarily or never.
Authority laundering is a structural failure mode, so it must be traced end to end rather than asserted away.
primitives: expiry, review condition, and re-tasking event
failure_mode: Biased toward steelmanning the incumbent Scout, so may under-weight candidates that displace it entirely.
Can over-engineer metadata and grading schemas past what a small agent runtime can enforce, inflating implementation cost.
Treats exploration policy and search budget as someone else's problem, so its candidates may emit reports without changing behavior.
Weak on subtraction and pruning; reconnaissance doctrine accumulates product.
Prone to importing institutional apparatus (compartments, clearances) that has no agent-runtime analogue.
